# World Composting

## Overview
World Composting is a comprehensive resource for composting education, featuring guides, checklists, video playlists, gear recommendations, and blog posts covering worm composting, hot composting, bokashi, biochar, and sustainable living.

## Site Structure

### Home & Site
- [Home — Latest Videos, Checklists & Gear](https://www.worldcomposting.com/)
- [Start Here — Decision Guide](https://www.worldcomposting.com/start-here.html)
